businessDifference.conflictSummary: G017 清除天庭本地七模板 probe 并直接 Cloud fallback，且 Client 又用 2.5 秒墙钟淘汰多谢后的封妖符资格；同步观察循环实际周期包含 HTTP 往返，正确弹窗可在下一次采样前被资格门丢弃。
businessDifference.userDecision: 仅对天庭恢复 G014：exact no-movement 后 known local templates 优先，all-miss 才 Cloud fallback；Dialog 可见时禁止 Tracker reopen；删除多谢后的 2.5 秒墙钟门，改为 DUOXIE 成功后建立、FENGYAO 成功或 interest/run 清理时结束的本地状态。

connectivity.producer: TiantingTask exact Tracker click 经 Runner legStarted=false 后安装 TIANTING_RECOVERY_OPTION；WindowObservationSampler 在 exact HWND shared frame 上匹配、fresh 复验并点击七张已知模板，发布稳定 actionKey 的 TIANTING_DIALOG_CLICKED。
connectivity.transport: ObservationKeyEvent 经 Cloud observer 映射为 exact TIANTING_DIALOG_ANSWERED 或 TIANTING_RECOVERY_ALL_MISSED ready event，保留 current task run/window/HWND observation binding；all-miss detail 原样携带 Cloud 为本轮 recovery 生成的唯一 probeCorrelation。
connectivity.consumer: TiantingTask 在 unknown-phase fallback 前消费已执行的 known actionKey，经 consumeDialogOutcome 复用 DUOXIE/FENGYAO 等既有业务语义；只有 Client exact frame 发布且 probeCorrelation 与当前 recovery 完全一致的 retained all-miss 才允许 generic Cloud fallback，迟到或外来终态被忽略。
connectivity.ordering: tracker click -> exact no movement -> unique probeCorrelation -> recovery probe -> known event wins OR matching retained all-miss -> at most one fallback; elapsed time and stale recovery terminal never become all-miss proof

proves: no-movement installs TIANTING_RECOVERY_OPTION instead of clearing it
known local event is consumed before generic fallback
DUOXIE and FENGYAO preserve existing task consumers
fallback remains reachable only after exact retained all-miss
retained all-miss from recovery A cannot authorize recovery B
visible option/coordinate dialog cannot trigger tracker reopen

connectivity.producer: WindowObservationSampler 在 fresh 复验后实际点击 DUOXIE 成功，同一 Client 窗口运行态登记待处理 FENGYAO。
connectivity.transport: 状态保存在 exact WindowRuntimeContext，不经过同步 HTTP 往返，也不按采样年龄淘汰；观察循环后续 shared frame 继续匹配 FENGYAO。
connectivity.consumer: WindowObservationSampler 命中并 fresh 复验 FENGYAO 后执行一次原子点击、发布稳定 ACTION_FENGYAO，并立即清除待处理状态。
connectivity.ordering: DUOXIE executed -> pending FENGYAO survives arbitrary observation-cycle delay -> FENGYAO executed -> pending cleared; dialog interest clear or task reset also clears

proves: 多谢后的封妖符资格不接受 now/deadline 参数且不存在 2.5 秒年龄门
封妖符点击成功立即消费资格
Dialog interest 清除后资格失效，不能泄漏到后续阶段

connectivity.producer: Client WindowObservationSampler 为封妖符坐标点击登记 exact pathing intent，并只在同 intent 的逻辑 X/Y 变化后写 movementObservedAtMs；pixel diff 只调度坐标识别。
connectivity.transport: WindowPathingSnapshot 持续保留同一 ACTIVE intent，直到 Runner 发布 ARRIVED/STOPPED_AWAY 权威终态；Cloud 不用短时等待到期替代该终态，也不提前清 ACTIVE intent。
connectivity.consumer: TiantingTask 仅在同 intent 终态携带真实 movementObservedAtMs 时消费当前坐标并进入既有 tooltip-only 妖王幻影阶段；终态无移动证明时才清 STORY 并重试同一坐标。
connectivity.ordering: coordinate click -> exact intent remains pending across turns -> Runner exact terminal -> movement proof consumes coordinate OR no-movement STORY fallback retries same coordinate

proves: long continuous movement does not clear or re-click an ACTIVE exact intent
terminal with exact X/Y movement proof consumes the coordinate and enters the target phase
terminal without movement proof clears only STORY and retries the same coordinate
a short leg already terminal before the next Cloud pass still advances correctly
